data.one_liner: Generate Flutter ThemeExtensions from annotated templates with context accessors and no boilerplate.
data.what_it_does: Generates concrete ThemeExtension classes, copyWith, lerp, equality, debugFillProperties, and BuildContext extensions from abstract templates. Also aggregates theme implementations automatically via build_runner.
use_when: You want to avoid boilerplate code when implementing Flutter ThemeExtensions.
You need automatic aggregation of theme extensions into ThemeData.
You want context accessors for your custom theme extensions.
avoid_when: Your project does not use code generation or build_runner.
You prefer writing ThemeExtension classes manually.
strengths: Automates copyWith, lerp, equality, and hash code generation.
Generates BuildContext extensions for quick theme property access.
Aggregates all theme implementations into lists automatically.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner after making changes to theme templates.
Template constraints require specific constructor signatures.
data.setup_notes: Add theme_extensions_gen_annotations, theme_extensions_gen, and build_runner to your pubspec, then run dart run build_runner watch.
